arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import statistics

# Monthly Customs (tariff) net receipts for 1974 (in millions)
data = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

# Calculate population standard deviation (pstdev)
pstdev_val = statistics.pstdev(data)
mean_val = statistics.mean(data)

# Calculate Coefficient of Variation as percentage
cv = (pstdev_val / mean_val) * 100

print(f'Monthly data: {data}')
print(f'Mean: {mean_val}')
print(f'Population Stdev: {pstdev_val}')
print(f'CV: {cv}')
print(f'CV rounded to hundredths: {round(cv, 2)}')
"
